136:
He is a Slayer with a deformed, discolored hand, the infamous 'Ghost Hand' possessed by a ghost and shackled with an iron chain.
 
 - This melee character relies on the length of his sword to reach enemies.
 - Uses multi-target attack skills. 
 - Can learn the Guard skill.
 - Ghost skills: Area-effective magic skills.
 - Possesses high resistance against Shadow, but a low resistance against Light.
 
<Advancement: Weapon Master>Refusing his fate to succumb to the ghost's control, this Slayer has focused all his energy to become capable of wielding a variety of weapons.
 
 - The only Slayer class that can wield Lightsabres.
 - Can use special sword skills by learning each weapon mastery at a specific level.
 
<Advancement: Berserker>Slayer suffering from Khazan Syndrome.
 
 - Can use Berserk Mode.
- Uses the Importunate Life skill that keeps a Berserker from dying easily.
 - Can create a sword by using his blood.
 
<Advancement: Slayer>Captured by the immense power of Ghost, this Slayer has released his Ghost Hand from confinement to employ all its ghostly powers.
 
 - Can learn various Ghost skills.
 - Possesses significantly enhanced resistance against Shadow.
 
<Advancement: Asura>Slayer who has mastered the power of waves at the cost of his sight.
 
- Can wear Plate Armor.
 - Master Wave Sword skills.
 - Can dominate the area surrounding him by using his immense power of the waves.
 - Uses the Spirit Crescent skill.
137:
Fighter who has trained to strengthen a specific part of her body - fists, feet, shoulders, or shins - and fights using her specially trained body part.
 
 - Super melee character.
 - Employs high Vitality and Defense-enhancing skills.
 - Uses Submission skills: Suplex, Back Breaker, Spiral, etc.
- Low Kick is effective for interrupting enemy movement.
 
<Advancement: Nen Master>Fighter who has mastered the power of Nen, a fine energy circulating around the human body.
 
 - Able to detect surrounding objects with the power of Nen; easy to avoid blind spots.
 - Uses Nen Creature skills.
 
<Advancement: Street Fighter>Street-smart Fighter who has mastered the most effective and practical fighting skills.
 
 - Can mount on a stumbled enemy to continue attacking.
- Can specialize in bladed weapons such as Claws.
 - Utilizes a variety of secret tools.
 - Employs a high resistance against Poison; has a skill to apply poison on weapons and increase Atk..
 
<Advancement: Striker>Traditional Fighter who has spent most of her time to improve her physical power.
 
- Can use Boxing Gloves.
 - Specializes in kicking.
 - Can cast the Super Armor status on herself to resist enemy attack.
 
<Advancement: Grappler>Fighter who specializes in enemy grabbing skills.
 
- Uses various Grab skills.
 - Can master Grab skills: Spiral, Cancel Suplex, etc.
 - Possesses powerful suplex skills like Suplex Crash.
138:
The Gunner's dual gun fighting style can suppress enemies from a distance. He comes from Empyrean across the Middle Ocean. Although he's much taller than a Human man, he has lower Visual Range and Physical Strength.
 
 - This long range character's main weapon is a Gun.
 - Can use sub weapons: Gatling Gun, Flamethrower, etc.
 - Endows bullets with elemental attributes.
 
<Advancement: Ranger>Rangers are Gunners that are capable of surviving the tough Lawless District of Empyrean.
 
 - Specializes in using Revolvers.
 
 - Uses his legs in fighting, enhancing his melee attack capability.
 - Has a fast gun draw and firing speed.
 
<Advancement: Launcher>Gunner who specializes in wielding sub weapons in addition to guns.
 
 - Can use sub weapons that shoot powerful projectiles: flames, bombs, etc.
 - Can use Laser Rifles.
 
<Advancement: Mechanic>Gunner who is knowledgeable in robot and machine technologies.
 
 - Activates robots to support him during combat.
 - Uses mechs that can be combined and separated.
 - Summons bombers for air backup.
 
<Advancement: Spitfire>Gunner who specializes in handling grenades.
 
 - Uses Bandolier to increase grenade capacity.
 - Uses elemental grenade skills such as Ice Grenade and Fire Grenade.
 - Can summon a veteran sniper for backup.
139:
The Mage is gifted with a mysterious power called Magic. She appears to be a Human girl, but is actually from Pandemonium, a place hidden in a veil of mystery from the Humans of Arad Continent.
 
- Long range character using magic.
 - Can inflict great damage on a large area.
- Has considerably low Physical Strength and Defense; uses various skills to compensate for these weaknesses.
 
<Advancement: Elemental Master> Pure Mage who employs and intensifies the power of elements.
 
 - Uses powerful long range Magical Attack skills utilizing the power of 4 elements.
- Uses skills such as Arctic Feast to inflict great damage on large areas.
 - Can master a specific element to maximize that element's destructive power.
 
<Advancement: Summoner> Mage who summons Fairies and Monsters to fight for her.
 
 - Summon fairies of 4 elements.
 - Summon monsters through contracts.
 - Uses various skills to control her summoned creatures.
  - As her skill levels rise, her summoned creatures become more powerful, and the maximum summoning number of creatures increases.
 - Summons Kasijas the Fourth Apostle.
 
<Advancement: Witch> Curious Mage who has taken a great interest in science.
 
 - Carries a creature called a Familiar that was created through alchemy.
 - Uses various attack skills with magical devices that are created with her witchcraft.
 - Her witchcraft is incomplete and may cause unexpected effects during combat.
 - Can wear Leather Armor.\ - Can use the Witch's traditional weapon, Broomstick, that enables her to fly in the sky.
 
<Advancement: Battle Mage> Mage who has focused on physical combat skills to survive this tough world.
 
 - Specializes in melee attacks.
 - Create various Chasers from afar while fighting enemies within short range.
 - Specializes in Spears and Poles, performing fast and powerful attacks.
 - Wears Leather Armor; increases Attack Speed and Critical Chance.
 - Can transform into a female warrior with ultimate combat power.
 - The only Mage who can learn weapon masteries.

1525:
Mentorship System Guide
 
A. Add a Mentor or Apprentice
  1. In the Mentorship window, click "Add."
  2. Enter the character's name, click "Ok."
  3. If the character is at least 5 levels lower, they will be your Apprentice.
  4. If the character is at least 5 levels higher, they will be your Mentor.
 
B. Mentorship Restrictions
  1. Mentors must be at least Level 20.
  2. You cannot have more than one Mentor at a time.
  3. A Mentor cannot have more than two Apprentices.
 
C. Mentorship Benefits
Benefits are applied only when a Mentor and Apprentice party play together. If your Alliance level is 10, benefits are applied when a Mentor and Apprentice are logged in together.
 
  1. Gold Bonus: When an Apprentice gains gold, a percentage of the gold will be given to their Mentor.
 
  2. EXP Bonus: The Apprentice will receive Monster EXP + Dungeon Clear EXP + Bonus EXP simultaneously.
 
  3. Fatigue Bonus: According to Alliance Level, when an Apprentice burns a certain amount of Fatigue Points, their Mentor gains one.

35099: What is uncommon equipment?\nEquipment with blue names are higher in rank than common items. Various materials can be acquired from Disassembling items that are uncommon or higher in rank.
35102: What is Rare equipment?\nEquipment with purple names are higher in rank than uncommon equipment, and have valuable stats.
35103: What is Legacy equipment?\nLegacy equipment is the same in rank as Rare equipment, but is only acquired from Legacy Pots sold by Danjin, Manjin, Arin, Pokin, Kadin, and Coral.
35104: What is Chronicle equipment?\nEquipment with red names are higher in rank than Rare equipment, and can only be acquired in the Otherverse.
35105: What is Unique equipment?\nEquipment with dark pink names are higher in rank than Chronicle equipment. Most Unique items drop in normal dungeons very infrequently, and show up more in Hell Mode. Since they are very difficult to find, they have excellent stats.
35106: What is Boss Unique equipment?\nThese are the same as Unique equipment, but can only be found by defeating Boss Monsters in normal dungeons.
35107: What is Epic equipment?\nEquipment with yellow names are of the highest rank of items, with far superior stats. They can only be acquired through Hero Pots sold by Simona, the fortuneteller the West Coast, purchased from Magar, or through monster hunts in Hell Mode.

#Hell Party Visibility
Your party is being watched by the Hell Party, which is looking for a strong opponent from another dimension.
Whenever your party clears a Level 70 or higher Normal dungeon,
the Hell Party's desire to fight you will accumulate in demonic form.
When the Visibility is activated, you'll have a high chance of encountering the Hell Party in your next Normal dungeon.
* Hell Party Visibility can only be accumulated and used by party play.

[Visibility Accumulation and Encounter Areas]

- Pandemonium > Central Park > Metro Center
- Pandemonium > The Black Market > Harlem
101033000:
#Guide's Visibility
You and your party are being watched by Guide who wishes to interfere in Plane: Arad.
Whenever you clear a Level 96 or higher Normal dungeon,
the spacetime rifts that occur will accumulate in gauge form.
When the Visibility is activated, you'll have a high chance of encountering the Guide in your next Normal dungeon.
* Guide's Visibility accumulates in both solo and party play.
* In party play, the party members' average Visibility is displayed.
* The larger the party, the more Visibility accumulates.

[Visibility Accumulation and Encounter Areas]
- Empyrean > Path of Dawn > Old Ghent Palace
- Arad > Chest Town > Roschest and Black Purgatory
101033001:
#Mist Visibility
You and your party are being watched by eyes beyond the mist.
Whenever you clear a Normal dungeon in Seon's White Ocean area,
the mist gathers and thickens as if watching you.
When Mist Visibility is activated, you'll experience a Mist Phenomenon in your next Normal Dungeon.
* Mist Visibility accumulates and is available on an account basis.
* You can get up to 5 rewards a day per account.
* If your reward count is 0 or Mist Visibility is not activated, you'll enter the Normal dungeon.
* Mist Visibility and Reward count are reset daily at 9:00 UTC.
* In party play, the party members' average Visibility is displayed.
* The larger the party, the more Visibility accumulates.
* Visibility gains fluctuate daily.

[Visibility Accumulation and Encounter Areas]
- Seon > Clearmist Square > White Cloud Valley, Misty Plateau, and Solidaris

90015: Using shortcuts is the best way to navigate various interface windows in DFO.\n \nOpen the menu and click 'Hotkey' button to find out more useful shortcuts, and even map your own custom shortcut setting.
90016: Your character has limited carriage amount, so please use safe to organize items.\n \nAs your character level progresses, you can move items to another character in your account with Account Vault.
90017: Skills can be performed with command input.\n \nUsing skills with hotkeys is obviously more convinient. However, using skills with command costs less MP and has reduced cooldown.

90019: Fatigue Point (FP) refills daily bases. As soon as clock reaches 09:00 UTC, FP will be fully recovered automatically.\n \nIf FP doesn't recover on the time, please visit character selection menu and reconnect.
90020: All available quests will appear in Quest Book. Please complete them as many as possible to get familiar with DFO's lore.\nAmong many quest types, Epic quest is the most important above all. It contains main story progression, and yields highest reward output.
90021: You can choose a difficulty level every time you enter dungeon. Harder the difficulty gets, monsters will become stronger and act with smarter behaviors.\nChance of getting precious items is relevantly high in harder difficulties.
90022: Assembling party member is the best way to beat difficult dungeons.\n \nYou can create a party in town anytime, and invite members in the same channel.
90023: Type /help at chat window to find out more useful chat commands is DFO.\n \nMany actions can be done with chat commands such as forming a party, whisper, and etc.
90024: Hold left Alt key and left click on an equipment to lock. Locked items are secured from being sold, disassembled, or disposed.\n \nTo unlock the item, please do the same. It will take 48 hours to be unlocked.
90025: There are two types of damage in DFO: Physical and Magical.\n \nTo improve physical/magical damage output, focus your character build on each corresponding attributes (Strength/Intelligence) and Atk..
90026: Character status affects not only damage output, but also other various attributes such as HP/MP recovery, resistance, and etc.\n \nOpen My Status window and mouse over to attributes for more detailed information.
90027: Utilizing Elemental properties will greatly increase your attack performance.\n \nDifference between defender's elemental resistance and attacker's elemental damage boost determines the damage output bonus.
90028: Successful attack on an attacking enemy will count as a counter attack. (+25%% damage)\n \nBased on your character's critical attack chance attribute, there is a chance to perform a critical attack. (+50%% damage)

90030: Abnormal status affects a character/monster with negative influence for a set duration. \n \nWatch out for hostile attacks that inflict abnormal status.
90031: In skill tooltip, damage description with only digit is an Absolute type, and others with %% is percentage type. Each types have difference corresponding attributes.\n- Percentage: Piercing Atk.\n- Absolute: independent Atk.
90032: Reinforcement increases both physical and magical performance attritubes depending on item type.For example, reinforcing weapon will grant extra piercing Atk..\n \nTo reinforce your item, visit NPC Kiri in Underfoot.

[Behold the Annihilator]

Mission
- All missions can be attempted per character. 
- Challenge missions can only be attempted in solo play. 
- Challenge missions are only recorded if you clear the Unshackled difficulty. 
- Challenge mission records will show the character's best record. 
- "Screams" count will be increased when Largo's "Unshackled Gauge" recovers after "Collapse of Causality" has been cast.

Ranking 
- Records are not updated in real-time and are refreshed after calibration is complete. 
- Calibration will be completed at 00 min to 10 min every hour. 
- If a record is updated during calibration, it will be reflected after the next calibration. 
- If you achieve a mission during calibration, you can still receive its rewards normally. 
- "Character Information" will be shown according to their status at the time of when the record was updated. 

Reward 
- Largo's Greatsword will not be functional after the SEP 3 update. 
- This schedule is subject to change. 
- "Largo's Greatsword" cannot be used in the Training Center, Dusky Island, Exceed, Verge of Recollection dungeons, and Asrahan: Curtains of Mu.
